scenes.text: Whitening thins your enamel? Not quite.
Teeth whitening products can actually be safe for your enamel.

right.label: Fact
right.text: Whitening can be safe with proper use.

scenes.text: Most people experience only temporary sensitivity after whitening.

scenes.heading: Aftercare Tips
items: Avoid strongly colored foods and drinks for a day or two.
Follow your dentist's instructions for best results.
